allocations.rationale: Directly resolves question 1 by extracting exact cohort-specific numerators, denominators, and HPO terms for core hallmark phenotypes across all published FDXR cohorts.
Directly resolves questions 2 and 3 by establishing whether normal plasma/CSF glycine and intermittent lactate serve as reliable absent/discriminating criteria separating MMDS9B from MMDS1-3.
